 Supply for EV battery manufacturing over three years 
 View of POSCO headquarters in Gangnam-gu, Seoul ⓒ News1 DB 
POSCO Group has signed a long-term lithium supply contract with Chinese electric vehicle (EV) battery company CATL. POSCO Group announced on the 18th that it has concluded an agreement to supply lithium for EV battery manufacturing to CATL for three years from this year through 2028. CATL is the world’s largest EV battery company, with a market share of 40% in the global EV battery market. Its batteries are widely used not only in China but also in EVs produced by major European automakers. Some models of Hyundai Motor Group EVs, including Kia’s Ray, Niro, EV5 and PV5, are also equipped with CATL batteries.
Recently, POSCO Group has made the securing of high-quality resources a core corporate strategy and has been steadily expanding its lithium-related business. It has secured its supply chain by successively investing in lithium brine mines in Argentina and mines in Australia, and it is operating a lithium production plant in Gwangyang, Gwangju, Jeollanam-do.
POSCO Group stated, “We signed the contract with CATL based on the production base established by proactively securing high-quality lithium resources,” adding, “By solidifying our sales base in China, the world’s largest EV battery market, we will strengthen our position in the global lithium market.”
 Lee Won-joo
